messages.body: Implementation review identified unresolved public inspection contracts before safe completion: how should the bridge prove exact invoking terminal principal/active-worker role and owning Run, recover a previously answered question after reload without replying again, and verify release/reuse/retain via worker-show? Current local draft passes 22 offline tests but is NOT acceptance-ready and I will not claim steps 2–5 complete without these contracts; please provide scout evidence or authorize an explicitly blocked draft handoff.
